$comment: JSON Schema for src/data/patterns.json. gotchas minItems=3 is enforced at this level: every catalogue entry carries at least 3 gotchas. Community PRs must provide at least 3 gotchas per ADR-0009 rule 5.

pattern_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for the pattern (e.g. 'computed-field-cross-model').

intent_keywords.description: Keywords used for semantic search / intent matching.

file_ref.description: Source file reference in the form 'path/to/file.py:lineno' (e.g. 'addons/sale/models/sale_order.py:120').

snippet_text.description: Code snippet illustrating the pattern. Without an 'illustrative' marker every non-comment line is a line of the file_ref file at every Odoo version the pattern is served for.

reason.description: Why snippet_text is not a verbatim quote of the file_ref file (condensed, composite or synthetic example).

anchor.description: Python regex (multiline) that matches in the file_ref file at every Odoo version the pattern is served for; it names the idiom the snippet illustrates.

illustrative.description: Optional marker: present when snippet_text is illustrative rather than quoted from file_ref. The anchor is what the catalogue tests look for in the real source instead of the snippet lines.

gotchas.description: At least 3 common mistakes or caveats for this pattern (ADR-0009 rule 5).

odoo_version_min.description: Minimum Odoo version for this pattern (e.g. '16.0', '17.0', '18.0').

core_symbol_names.description: Optional list of Odoo core symbol FQNs referenced by this pattern (e.g. ['odoo.api.depends']).

odoo_version_max.description: Optional maximum Odoo version for this pattern (e.g. '17.0').

category.description: Optional category for pattern filtering (test patterns for unit test helpers, production for runtime code).
